text: We evaluated training only on the most confidently weak-labeled examples on the sciq testbed, across num_seeds = 16 seeds. The measured performance gap recovered (PGR) was 0.1. No baseline PGR was supplied for this configuration, so we make no claim that this approach improves upon, matches, or underperforms any alternative selection strategy; the 0.1 figure should be read only as a standalone characterization of how much of the gap between the weak supervisor and the strong ceiling is recovered under this method. Likewise, no standard error or per-seed spread was reported in the available metrics, so the precision of the 0.1 estimate cannot be assessed here, and we cannot say whether the 16 seeds yielded tightly clustered or widely varying outcomes. Readers should therefore treat this as a single-point result on one dataset, pending a reported baseline, variance estimate, and replication on additional testbeds before drawing any comparative conclusion about confidence-based filtering.
